summary.intent: Land a set of performance and correctness changes to the caliper tool: reduce filesystem calls (#518), derive isReadonlySymbol locally from symbol flags, and address a reviewer finding about a lost tsconfig warning caused by the shared resolver cache.
summary.outcome: #518 was verified and published (25-57% fewer fs calls, identical output, modest wall gain), the readonly worker was launched with an approved two-line test scope extension, and the medium finding was confirmed as a real regression in #518 with a fix worker dispatched but not yet pushed.

repo: Sharing one resolver cache per revision (#518) means any diagnostic derived from the cache after the dependency loader warms it can be silently altered; validation must use a fresh resolver cache.

Verification gates for perf changes: first-answer, memory, determinism, lint, checker lane, nextest, plus output identity across 5 corpora (Mantine, Chakra, shadcn, antd, spectrum) in default and `--collapse-inherited-props none`.
Spectrum output differs from the old comparison binary only due to the #512 private-member rename (767 renames), so comparison binaries must be built from a post-#512 main.
The large remaining filesystem cost (~1,000 samples in realpath, read_file, exists) belongs to tsrs, not caliper; a tsrs realpath memo is for other sessions.
Adding `readonly: Option<bool>` to SymbolInfo requires `readonly: None` in test struct literals at crates/semantic/src/component.rs:291 and crates/semantic/src/declared.rs:315.
typed request structs and the readonly change both rewrite rpc.rs, so they must be sequenced rather than parallel.

code.finding: Governing tsconfig validation happens here after dependency loading; with a shared resolver cache it can accept a cached entry lacking its references and drop the missing-reference warning.
Validation on the reused resolver accepts the cached governing config entry, so the 'Could not use the tsconfig' warning is lost.
Dependency loading can reach resolve_file for a bare alias under a nested config, warming the resolver cache before validation.
Import resolution path through which a nested tsconfig referencing the governing config by filename gets cached without its references.

friction: Subagent's stash drop was blocked by the classifier, requiring manual cleanup by the lead.
Shadcn wall time initially read 1.28 -> 1.60 s under heavy load and required 10 interleaved reruns to dismiss as noise.
The user had to re-ask about the open finding because the earlier response had not made clear it was the same issue already dispatched.
The byte-identical output claim for #518 was invalidated by the finding after being stated.
open_items: Fix the lost tsconfig missing-reference warning on #518 (fresh-cache validation), with a failing-first test, class sweep (lazy start path, watch update path), and mutation proof; the branch is still at a1bf15e4.
Resolve the finding on Entire after the fix is pushed, citing commit and test; hold #518 merge until then.
Readonly-from-flags worker is still running; its result is pending.
Typed request structs are queued after the readonly change.
No failing-on-revert test exists for the single-flight and shared-resolver wiring in #518.
tsrs realpath memo is to be handled by other tsrs sessions.
